resources.string: Learns from the times you hit a neighboring key by mistake and slowly shifts each key\'s tap area toward where you actually tap. It improves the more you type, so you can type faster without aiming so carefully.

Dots show where you recently tapped each letter, compared with the key. The marker and line show how far that key has shifted to match you. Only words you finish are used, never passwords or incognito typing. Only tap positions are saved, never what you type.
Nothing learned yet. Type as usual for a while and your heatmap will show up here.
\"Adapt keys to my typing\" is off. What it learned is kept, but not used or updated.
This deletes everything Pluto has learned about where you tap, in portrait and landscape. It can\'t be undone. Keys work as normal until it learns again.
Reduces typos by learning from where you really tap. Open to see your heatmap, switch it off or reset it.
